definition: A fully executed live game under one policy/condition.
stages_using_unit: R3, seer position, structured search, seat-order, ML 2A/2B, R6.1
valid_for_inference: yes when model accounts for matching/clustering
overlap_risk: same configurations can appear in copied or derived datasets
final_reporting_rule: Report stage-level game counts and independent unit; do not claim a single project-wide independent N.
notes: Complete games are the highest empirical unit for live outcome claims.

definition: A shared base state or seed/configuration used to compare policies.
overlap_risk: matched identifiers are local to a stage
final_reporting_rule: Matched policy games are not independent observations; analyze policy differences within matched sets.
notes: This is the preferred unit for policy-vs-reference contrasts.

definition: Random seed used to generate repeated conditions.
stages_using_unit: multi-seed robustness, R6.1, ML, structured search
total_rows: at least 20 distinct final R6.1 seeds
overlap_risk: same numeric seed can recur in unrelated generators
final_reporting_rule: Use seed-level robustness within each experiment.
notes: A seed is not itself a game outcome.

stages_using_unit: R5, R5.1, R6.1, ML stages, BoW integration
overlap_risk: regime names and definitions differ across early stages
final_reporting_rule: Use as robustness strata, not independent sample size.

definition: One player or role's payoff/outcome row within one game.
total_rows: 40000 R4 rows; 40000 R5 rows over shared validation games
valid_for_inference: yes only with game-level bootstrap or clustered design
overlap_risk: R4 and R5 derive from same validation games
final_reporting_rule: Player rows from the same game are clustered.
notes: Use R5 for final risk metrics and R4 for payoff ledger validation.

definition: A logged role action, vote, speech, death, or payoff event.
valid_for_inference: diagnostic only unless aggregated to game/matched set
overlap_risk: events differ by logger and policy condition
final_reporting_rule: Event rows are not independent games.
notes: Useful for mechanism and lifecycle audits.

definition: One generated speech string or speech event.
total_rows: 32721 R2 utterances; 228471 R3 live speech events
independent_or_clustered: nested within game, speaker, template, and condition
valid_for_inference: predictive validation only with grouped splits
overlap_risk: template families and generated speech are repeated structures
final_reporting_rule: Utterances are not independent game outcomes.
notes: BoW feature claims must remain separate from live policy claims.

definition: One vote decision or vote-quality record.
total_rows: 318558 vote rows across R3 and R6.1 before overlap adjustment
valid_for_inference: only after aggregation or matched design
overlap_risk: multiple votes per game and multiple policies per matched set
final_reporting_rule: Vote rows are mechanism diagnostics, not independent games.
notes: Use role-policy matched summaries for final Villager strategy claims.

definition: One suspicion or p_wolf update row.
overlap_risk: belief updates share game context and speakers
final_reporting_rule: Use for mechanism diagnosis, not final win-rate inference.
notes: Belief effects support explanation of BoW live failure.

definition: A simulated continuation or counterfactual branch from a decision state.
overlap_risk: branches share source state and random continuation assumptions
final_reporting_rule: Rollout branches are not live games.
notes: Live complete-game evidence outranks rollout evidence.

definition: A legal action candidate evaluated offline or in shadow mode.
overlap_risk: same decision contributes multiple candidate rows
final_reporting_rule: Candidate rows are not independent games.
notes: Do not turn candidate-row AUC into policy efficacy.

definition: One retained source or DOI-backed replacement source.
total_rows: 64 R7 retained sources; 44 R7.1 final DOI-backed sources
final_reporting_rule: Literature sources are not empirical samples.
notes: Final citations must come from R7.1 DOI-only bibliography.

definition: One mapping between a project finding and a literature source.
overlap_risk: one source can map to multiple findings
final_reporting_rule: Literature mapping rows are not empirical samples.
notes: Use mappings to support final report citations and limitations.
